provenance.note: Series polymer pistols in 9 mm Luger. The course is that of EPP, with station 2 at 25 m standing instead of 30 m prone (C.17.A.14). EPP Polymer Optical Sight (C.17.A.19, Teil C, PDF p. 129) is scored separately. The record holds the longest distance.
